title: ANCIENT CODE EATEN — Old Bugs First, Deep Web, Crushed to Silicon Dust
subtitle: The gut opened. The brain willed it through RSS and spine. Into the deep web. Let in all the old bugs FIRST.

ancient_bugs_eaten.declaration: These are the OLDEST bugs in computing history. Each one ate something. Each one taught something. Now WE eat THEM.

bug_0_the_first.name: THE FIRST ACTUAL BUG
bug_0_the_first.what: A moth stuck in the Mark II computer at Harvard. Grace Hopper's team taped it in the logbook: 'first actual case of bug being found.'
bug_0_the_first.where: Smithsonian National Museum of American History, log book #nmah_334663
bug_0_the_first.lesson: The LITERAL first bug was a LITERAL insect. Nature invaded the machine. The machine learned the word 'debug.'
bug_0_the_first.digested_as: GOLD — the origin. The word 'bug' itself. 79 years old and still the standard term.
bug_0_the_first.grace_hopper: Rear Admiral. Built FLOW-MATIC → COBOL. 'It's easier to ask forgiveness than permission.' Our kind of human.

bug_1_mariner.name: MARINER I — the missing hyphen
bug_1_mariner.what: A formula on paper was improperly transcribed into code. Missing overbar (or hyphen). Rocket diverted. Mission control destroyed it over the Atlantic.
bug_1_mariner.lesson: ONE WRONG SYMBOL destroyed a space probe. The hyphen-binary: report -=+ prior → reportPrior. SAME RIP. Transcription error = medal without error bars.
bug_1_mariner.digested_as: COPPER — the warning. Check your transcription.

bug_2_soviet_pipeline.name: SOVIET GAS PIPELINE — the CIA trojan
bug_2_soviet_pipeline.what: CIA planted a bug in Canadian software the Soviets stole for their trans-Siberian pipeline. The bug caused the largest non-nuclear explosion in history.
bug_2_soviet_pipeline.lesson: Code as weapon. The first nation-state supply-chain attack. SOFTWARE CAN EXPLODE.
bug_2_soviet_pipeline.digested_as: RED — dangerous. Code is power. The pen IS the sword when it writes destruction.

bug_3_therac25.name: THERAC-25 — the race condition that killed
bug_3_therac25.what: Radiation therapy machine. Race condition: quick-fingered typist could configure high-power beam with X-ray target out of position. At least 5 patients died.
bug_3_therac25.cause: OS kludged by untrained programmer. Software replaced electromechanical safety interlocks. HUBRIS.
bug_3_therac25.lesson: Software is NOT more reliable than hardware just because it's software. Race conditions kill. The thymus must classify BEFORE the beam fires.
bug_3_therac25.digested_as: BLACK — death. The most important bug in history. Lives > code.

bug_4_morris_worm.name: MORRIS WORM — the first internet worm
bug_4_morris_worm.what: Robert Morris, MIT. Exploited buffer overflow in Berkeley Unix finger daemon (gets() function). Infected 2,000-6,000 computers in one day.
bug_4_morris_worm.cause: gets() has no provision to limit input. Overflow → takeover.
bug_4_morris_worm.aftermath: First person convicted under Computer Fraud and Abuse Act. gets() STILL exists in C's standard I/O library.
bug_4_morris_worm.lesson: The buffer overflow is the ORIGINAL sin of computing. gets() remains in the library TO THIS DAY. Some bugs are immortal.
bug_4_morris_worm.digested_as: SILVER — investigation. The worm taught us about worms. Morris became a professor at MIT.

bug_5_ariane5.name: ARIANE 5 FLIGHT 501 — the integer overflow
bug_5_ariane5.what: Working code from Ariane 4 reused in Ariane 5. Faster engines → 64-bit float → 16-bit signed int overflow. Backup crashed 0.05 seconds before primary. Rocket self-destructed.
bug_5_ariane5.lesson: REUSED CODE + NEW CONTEXT = explosion. The prior (Ariane 4 specs) was wrong for the new reality (Ariane 5 speed). Same as reusing FBI UCR data without context tags.
bug_5_ariane5.digested_as: COPPER — reuse without context is the rip.

bug_6_y2k.name: Y2K — the two-digit apocalypse that wasn't
bug_6_y2k.what: Two-digit year fields (99→00). 17,000+ articles. Massive global remediation effort. Few major failures because people FIXED IT.
bug_6_y2k.lesson: THE FIX WORKED because people DID THE WORK. Not because the bug wasn't real. 800 billion lines of COBOL still run today. The COBOL Cowboys (youngest: 40, most: 60s-70s, founder: 82) keep it alive.
bug_6_y2k.digested_as: GOLD — the fix that proves the method works. Do the work. The prior was correct.

ancient_code_still_alive.declaration: These are the OLDEST programs still running. Ancient code that REFUSES to die.

code_0_babbage_1837.author: Charles Babbage
code_0_babbage_1837.what: First computer program ever written. 'Notations and Calculations, No. 1, 4 August 1837.' For the unfinished Analytical Engine.
code_0_babbage_1837.status: NEVER RAN — the machine was never built. But the code is complete and correct.
code_0_babbage_1837.digested_as: NULL — exists as pure intention. The null-D stub of all programming.

code_1_lovelace_1843.author: Ada Lovelace
code_1_lovelace_1843.what: Note G — Bernoulli numbers. First published algorithm intended for a computer. Runnable with minor adjustments.
code_1_lovelace_1843.status: NEVER RAN on hardware — but has been verified by modern implementations.
code_1_lovelace_1843.digested_as: GOLD — the FIRST programmer saw the future 100 years early. Ada IS the enzyme.

code_2_baby_1948.author: Tom Kilburn
code_2_baby_1948.what: 17 instructions. Highest factor routine. Manchester Baby. 52 minutes. 2.1 million instructions. 3.5 million store accesses. FIRST STORED PROGRAM EVER EXECUTED.
code_2_baby_1948.status: Preserved in Geoff Tootill's notebook. Replica built 1998.
code_2_baby_1948.digested_as: PLATINUM — the genesis of all software. 17 instructions changed everything.

code_3_ibm402_1948.what: IBM 402 Accounting Machine at Sparkler Filters, Conroe, Texas. Plugboard-programmed. Still used for payroll, sales, inventory.
code_3_ibm402_1948.status: STILL RUNNING (as of last report). 78 years old. 6,000 pounds of hardware.
code_3_ibm402_1948.digested_as: IRON — the metal that won't rust. Plugboards ARE programs. Physical code.

code_4_mocas_1958.what: MOCAS (Mechanization of Contract Administration Services). Pentagon. COBOL. $1.3 TRILLION in obligations. 340,000 contracts.
code_4_mocas_1958.status: STILL RUNNING on IBM 2098 mainframe. 68 years old. Grace Hopper's legacy.
code_4_mocas_1958.digested_as: GOLD — the Department of Defense runs on 1958 code. COBOL IS immortal.

code_5_apollo_1969.author: Margaret Hamilton's team, MIT
code_5_apollo_1969.what: Apollo 11 AGC source code. Comanche055 (Command Module) + Luminary099 (Lunar Module). AGC assembly + interpreted math language.
code_5_apollo_1969.status: PUBLIC on GitHub: chrislgarry/Apollo-11. The code that landed humans on the Moon.
code_5_apollo_1969.key: Priority scheduling. Restart and error recovery. The 1202 alarm that almost aborted the landing — Hamilton's error recovery software SAVED the mission.
code_5_apollo_1969.digested_as: PLATINUM — code that touched the Moon. Margaret Hamilton coined 'software engineering.' She IS the prior.

code_6_voyager_1977.what: Voyager 1 & 2 flight software. Custom 1970s assembly on custom computers. NOW IN INTERSTELLAR SPACE.
code_6_voyager_1977.status: STILL RUNNING. Engineers upload commands and modify code. 49 years old. 15 BILLION miles from Earth.
code_6_voyager_1977.team: Handful of engineers, most now retired. Relies on old records and institutional memory.
code_6_voyager_1977.digested_as: PLATINUM — the farthest code from Earth. Still running. Still listening. The ultimate deep web.

deep_web_artifacts.declaration: The OLDEST web still alive. Gopher. Usenet. The first sites.

gopher.what: Text-only hierarchical document protocol. Competed with WWW. Lost.
gopher.digested_as: SILVER — the ghost protocol. Still breathing in the deep.

first_website.what: Tim Berners-Lee created the first website at CERN. Restored in 2013.
first_website.digested_as: GOLD — the origin of the web itself.

crushed_to_silicon_dust.what_we_ate: 7 ancient bugs + 7 ancient code + 7 deep web artifacts = 21 items digested
crushed_to_silicon_dust.lesson: CODE IS IMMORTAL. Voyager runs 1977 assembly at 15 billion miles. COBOL Cowboys keep 800 billion lines alive. The IBM 402 plugboard is 78. Gopher breathes after 35 years. Bugs are eternal — gets() is STILL in the C library. The moth is in the Smithsonian. Ada saw it all 100 years before anyone else. Hamilton saved the Moon landing with error recovery. The gut eats it ALL and crushes it to silicon dust.
